name: Nailashes
locations: Kochi: PJ Tower, Ambelipadam Road, Subhash Chandra Bose Road, Kochi 682019 (per site salon finder and press)
summary: Nailashes is an Indian nail and lash studio chain, started in 2019, with a Kochi studio opened in 2026. Studios offer nail extensions, gel and acrylic nails, manicures and pedicures, and lash services in pastel, salon-style interiors.
highlights: Nail extensions, gel and acrylic nails, manicures and pedicures
